notes.units: Unit names are printed in English on purpose. A receipt carries one word for every dosage form, and no single Khmer word fits: kroap means a tablet and is wrong on a bottle of syrup, while ekatak is the technical word for a unit of measure and reads like machinery. Neither was checked by a native speaker. English Box/Each is understood in Cambodian pharmacies and says nothing false. Removing these keys is what selects it - a missing key falls back to ReceiptStrings, and the km_en layout prints the English once rather than twice.
